caption: The drawing depicts the upper part of a person’s head and shoulders. The main object is a large, elaborately draped headdress, colored in a pale tan with light brown shading, and detailed with fine lines. The headdress includes a round decorative element and a long, oval flap edged with lace on the left side. A lace-edged border runs along the outer edge of the headdress, and the lace is depicted in sprays of delicate, scalloped lines. The hair is drawn in pencil with visible curved strands around the temples and gathered on each side into two large curls. The person’s face is not detailed, except for some faint outlines of the eyebrows, nose, and lips. Around the neck is a scalloped-edge collar with a round, flower-shaped brooch at the center. Below this figure, there is a smaller, incomplete sketch of the headdress and its large oval flap. The overall color palette is minimal, with the tan headdress being the only colored element, while the remainder is rendered in fine, light pencil on an off-white background.
title: Headdress
